searchBreadth: Owner-selected story; no substitute topics or fabricated broad search. Inspected official dispatch, Naval Historical Branch brief, eyewitness report transcriptions and official photograph catalog records.

poolReview.rationale: Striking authentic three-ship arrangement and specific fuel-delivery stakes independently justify this owner-selected story.

candidates.subject: SS Ohio: the tanker brought into Malta between warships
candidates.novelty: Arrival through physical assistance, rather than general WWII chronology.
candidates.evidenceFeasibility: Hill report explicitly records Penn and Bramham secured either side; official dispatch and NHB corroborate arrival, attacks and fuel significance.
candidates.explanatoryPayoff: Understand the side-by-side assistance and why delivering the surviving fuel mattered more than recovering a working ship.
candidates.visualPotential: Authentic frontal and harbour photos plus original labeled towing reconstruction.
candidates.audienceCuriosity: Why would warships fasten themselves to a crippled tanker?
candidates.productionFeasibility: Public-domain official photographs and modest original animation; no paid services or speculative photorealistic battle scenes.
candidates.portfolioDiversity: Classify after owner selection; history is neither preferred nor excluded.
candidates.comparison: Exact owner selection; no autonomous comparison claimed.
limitations: Photo captions differ over assisting ship identities and cargo totals.
No naval structural analysis quantifying shared buoyancy.

curiosityReview.honestPremise: A severely damaged fuel tanker reached Malta with a destroyer secured to either side and other vessels helping tow.
curiosityReview.coldAudienceReason: The unusual side-by-side rescue creates an immediate physical question answered by a visible arrangement.
curiosityReview.storyRoute: Three ships → besieged destination and fuel → disabled tanker → towing/steering problem → alongside assistance → arrival → fuel delivery.

truthBoundary.rationale: Use lashed alongside rather than unquantified hold-it-up mechanism. No literal cut-in-half claim.

opportunityJudgment.rationale: Authentic extraordinary scene and understandable logistical payoff.
